title: Lakshya Sen, Unnati Hooda Advance at World Championships
indian_angle: This report highlights the progress of two promising Indian shuttlers, Lakshya Sen and Unnati Hooda, at a major tournament.
summary: Home favourites Lakshya Sen and Unnati Hooda took some time to adapt before finding their rhythm and unleashing their attacking flair to progress.

title: Treesa Jolly, Gayatri Gopichand Advance to Second Round
indian_angle: The promising Indian women's doubles pair of Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand secured their spot in the second round of the BWF World Championships.
summary: Treesa-Gayatri advanced to the second round with a fighting win at BWF World's.

title: Ayush Shetty Stuns Defending Champion Shi Yu Qi at World Championships
indian_angle: Young Indian shuttler Ayush Shetty achieved a significant upset by defeating the defending world champion, Shi Yu Qi, at the BWF World Championships.
summary: Ayush Shetty upset world champion Shi Yu Qi at the BWF World Championships, winning 21-14, 13-21, 21-19, showcasing skill and determination.

title: PV Sindhu Cruises in Opening Match at World Championships
indian_angle: India's badminton icon PV Sindhu began her BWF World Championships campaign with a dominant victory, aiming for a record sixth medal.
summary: PV Sindhu won her first match at the BWF World Championships, defeating Sophia Noble 21-7, 21-11, and aims for a historic sixth medal.

title: India Hosts World Championships After 17-Year Wait
indian_angle: This feature celebrates the return of the BWF World Championships to India after 17 years, highlighted by a stunning upset from home favourite Ayush Shetty.
summary: The BWF World Championships in New Delhi kicked off on an auspicious note for the home shuttlers with Ayush Shetty taking the badminton world by storm.
